Passive.description: Scheduled frequency of broadcast Cooperative Awareness Messages containing baseline telemetry.

Active.description: Active prioritization message handled when an approaching police vehicle requests a green signal corridor.

Dynamic.description: Real-time volatile tracking of remaining seconds before the active traffic signal changes phase.

Location.description: Geometric intersection identifier mapped alongside absolute geographic coordinates.

Equipment.description: Cryptographic public key infrastructure serial number validating authorized infrastructure communication.

Status.description: Hardware diagnostic state highlighting if an active traffic light element is burned out.

User.description: Identifier of the centralized municipal traffic management operator overriding the system.

Operational.description: Internal operational logs logging exceptions across C-V2X or ITS-G5 radio interfaces.

Service.description: On-demand intersection topology data detailing lanes, crosswalks, and geometric restrictions.

RFID.description: RFID switch logging unauthorized physical opening of the roadside equipment cabinet.

Historical.description: Aggregated historical vehicle throughput metrics used for anomaly baseline generation.

Spectrum.description: Channel load ratio measurement indicating congestion levels within the 5.9 GHz automotive band.

Environmental.description: Physical infrared roadway surface temperature reading used to predict ice formation.
